approach: Reference architecture outline for Production-Oriented Inventory Management Platform: Build a Rust backend that manages products, stock levels, inventory movements, and application users through a documented API.

implementation_steps: Implement and test: Modular domain model using structs, enums, traits, and validated types..
Implement and test: HTTP API with request validation and consistent error responses..
Implement and test: Database persistence, transactions, and schema migrations..
Implement and test: Authentication and authorization via an appropriately selected maintained library..
Implement and test: Tests for domain logic, API behavior, and database integration..
Implement and test: Structured logging, configuration, graceful shutdown, and release automation..
Implement and test: Performance measurements and architecture decision notes..
stretch_features: Add inventory audit trails and idempotency keys.
Add load tests and documented performance limits.
reference_outline.quality_gate: Run cargo fmt, cargo clippy, cargo test, and relevant integration/target tests in a clean environment before reviewing for publication.

review_checklist: Verify each required feature against the 100-point rubric.
Run relevant tests on the declared stable toolchain and target.
Review security, ownership, external service failure, and shutdown paths.
Do not publish this solution outline as a complete production implementation without expert review.
